item.title: From civil rights to clickbait: Dave Chappelle’s take on Charlie Kirk comparison with Martin Luther King Jr
item.description: Dave Chappelle has strongly refuted comparisons between conservative commentator Charlie Kirk and civil rights leader Martin Luther King Jr. Chappelle emphasized that while both are well-known, their influence stems from vastly different contexts: King's grassroots activism versus Kirk's algorithm-driven online presence. He argued that equating a digital influencer with a historical icon fundamentally misunderstands King's legacy.

item.title: Who was Epic Gamer Grandma? Viral TikTok star Agnes passes away at 78
item.description: Beloved TikTok sensation Agnes, the 'Epic Gamer Grandma,' has passed away at 78. Her grandson confirmed her peaceful departure, surrounded by family. Agnes captivated over 2 million followers with her gaming humor and inspiring optimism, proving age is no barrier to online influence. Her legacy of joy and creativity will endure.

item.title: Poll shock: Trump’s longtime critic Jerome Powell is more popular than the president
item.description: A recent Gallup poll reveals Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell as the most popular senior US leader, surpassing President Trump. Powell's 44% approval rating outshines Trump's 36%, despite the President's repeated criticism. Secretary of State Marco Rubio also ranked high. The survey highlights deep partisan divides affecting all tested figures.

item.title: 'Nepotism never fails': Indian-origin FedEx CEO Raj Subramaniam draws flak over H-1B hiring
item.description: FedEx is hiring more foreign workers on H-1B visas and reducing American jobs. This shift follows a major government contract. The company's CEO, Rajesh Subramaniam, faces social media backlash. Data shows a surge in H-1B applications coinciding with potential layoffs. This hiring pattern raises concerns about the impact on American employment. Read here to know more!

item.title: $5.3 million for a Pokémon card? Why Youtuber Logan Paul says it’s worth every penny
item.description: In a bold move that underscores the growing allure of collectibles, YouTuber Logan Paul has snagged a rare Pikachu Illustrator Pokémon card for a staggering $5 million. This prized card, once awarded during an art contest in Japan back in 1998, is esteemed for its rarity—only a handful exist, and even fewer are in pristine condition.

item.title: IShowSpeed dominates YouTube Gaming in 2025 as most-watched streamer
item.description: IShowSpeed has dominated YouTube Gaming viewership in 2025, amassing an impressive 64.1 million hours. His diverse content, from gaming marathons to global travel streams, captivated audiences worldwide. He also led in average concurrent viewers, showcasing his immense popularity and setting the stage for an even bigger year ahead with a massive African tour.

item.title: "My dad had to shave his beard": Zohran Mamdani's wife Rama Duwaji recalls how 9/11 changed her childhood
item.description: Rama Duwaji, wife of New York City's new mayor, Zohran Mamdani, shares her story. She discusses growing up with Islamophobia after 9/11 and her family's move to Dubai. Duwaji emphasizes her use of fashion to express political views, particularly for Palestine. She plans to continue her artistic career alongside her new role. Read here to know more!

item.title: ‘Indian passport no longer adds value to my life’: Tech educator frustrated over visa hurdles
item.description: Tech educator Kunal Kushwaha highlighted the significant hurdles faced by Indian passport holders working globally, citing visa complexities and paperwork that disrupt travel plans. His viral post detailed the exhaustion from constant applications and the limitations imposed by India's low passport strength, impacting professionals' ability to travel freely for work and collaboration.

item.title: Kai Cenat opens up again about mental health in a new Twitter thread
item.description: Popular streamer Kai Cenat has bravely shared his ongoing mental health journey, detailing struggles with self-doubt and pressure despite his career success. He revealed how the anime Naruto has provided him with courage and valuable life lessons on friendship and perseverance, even after facing mockery for his openness. Cenat's continued honesty underscores the importance of self-care and pursuing dreams.

item.title: 'Can be First Lady': Rama Duwaji's magazine cover has the internet ready to vote for 'President' Zohran Mamdani
item.description: New York's new First Lady, Rama Duwaji, is captivating the nation with her artistic flair and elegant style. The Syrian-born illustrator, married to Mayor Zohran Mamdani, has been praised for her magazine cover shoot, drawing comparisons to iconic artists and actresses. Duwaji, a Gen Z icon, aims to support her husband while leveraging her artistic background in her new role.

item.title: Dolphins aren’t cute : GoPro footage shows brutal, unsettling reality of how they hunt
item.description: Dolphins are often cast as playful, gentle creatures, but footage from GoPros attached to six wild bottlenose dolphins tells a different story. Trained by the US Navy, the animals were filmed hunting with precision, using sonar clicks, suction feeding and audible “victory squeals” as they consumed hundreds of fish, and even venomous sea snakes, revealing a far more primal side to their behaviour.

item.title: Why did Lamarr Wilson commit suicide? Inside the heartbreaking loss of the tech YouTuber who inspired millions
item.description: Lamarr Wilson, a well known Los Angeles based tech and lifestyle YouTuber with over 2.11 million subscribers, has died by suicide at 48. His death was confirmed by the Los Angeles County Medical Examiner and a family member. Tributes from Geoff Keighley and fans highlight Wilson’s lasting impact on the tech and creator community.
